long_biography.plain_text:
Business consultant Reuben Buttigieg helped bring Aviation Cosmetics from the Netherlands to Malta. His advisory work covered the company's relocation, the establishment of its aircraft-painting hangar at Safi Aviation Park and assistance in obtaining government incentives.

He also persuaded engineer Pietro Perlo to consider Malta as a manufacturing location for electric vehicles. Their discussions led to Malta Electromobility Manufacturing, supported by Malta Enterprise. The venture pursued electric bikes and planned a laboratory with COMAU to train employees for future manufacturing facilities. The venture also received European project funding through Fluently for work on human-robot interaction in manufacturing.
